query: How can educators improve learning satisfaction?

per_column.name: adaptive_content_delivery_strategy
per_column.rationale: Captures async/video/interactive delivery modes, a genuine axis for improving satisfaction. Values map soundly to text (ED-0004 video_recordings). 'not_present' dominates but is legitimate for silent rows.

per_column.name: synchronous_interaction_design
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes live participation quality, directly relevant to the query. ED-0005 silent_or_passive and ED-0001 microphone_barriers are well grounded. ED-0003 'microphone_barriers' is a slightly loose reading (text mentions teacher can't tell student is lost) but defensible.

per_column.name: peer_community_structure
per_column.rationale: Collaboration/isolation is a strong lever for satisfaction. ED-0003 isolated_individual_work grounded ('zero peer interaction'). Some rows default to isolated where text is silent, a mild over-assertion but reasonable.

per_column.name: hands_on_or_kinesthetic_access
per_column.rationale: Kinesthetic access is meaningful for remote-learning satisfaction. ED-0002 live_demonstrations_with_home_replication well grounded (kitchen-chemistry). Some 'pure_video' defaults are inferential but warranted.

per_column.name: feedback_turnaround_and_personalization
per_column.rationale: Feedback quality is a classic satisfaction driver. Heavily 'not_present' (162), but that is honest for silent rows and non-constant across the table.

per_column.name: technical_platform_stability
per_column.rationale: Reliability strongly affects satisfaction. Values well grounded: ED-0001 lags, ED-0003 frequent_disconnections. Somewhat skewed toward 'reliable' but that is a valid reading.

per_column.name: student_engagement_and_motivation_baseline
per_column.rationale: Useful axis to segment respondents. Somewhat more interpretive/inferred than extractive; ED-0001 'requires_external_structure' is a stretch from the text, but overall defensible categorisations.

per_column.name: developmental_stage_fit
per_column.rationale: Largely restates existing grade_level column, limiting new analytical leverage. Values are well grounded (ED-0002 middle_school from 'seventh graders'). Useful mainly if grade_level was missing.

per_column.name: subject_discipline_and_remote_fit
per_column.rationale: Grouping subjects by remote suitability is a strong analytical axis beyond raw subject. ED-0001 stem_lab_intensive (algebra) is a questionable fit and ED-0003 content_friendly for a struggling reader is loose, but mostly warranted.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively give rich, distinct analytical axes (delivery mode, synchronous design, community, kinesthetic access, feedback, platform stability, engagement, subject fit) directly serving the query on improving satisfaction. Most values are sound readings of the open responses, with occasional over-confident inferences on silent rows and one mildly redundant column (developmental_stage_fit vs grade_level). No clear hallucinations of invented facts observed; 'not_present'/NULL usage for silent rows is appropriate.
